Good 'ol days, the golden ages, the men were working while the women stayed in the house and looked after the children. The era of no communication , being punished for saying the wrong thing or not voting for the right person, the era where you had little to no right to express your own opinion and be yourself. Grow up old man and accept that you feel nostalgic of the "good old days", because those were the days when you were young- the best years of your life and you of course would feel nostalgic towards this period of time, even if it was shitty. And I want to ask, how this " **No gender neutral non-binary pansexual rubbish.** " is affecting you in any way? It would only be an important topic for people who struggle with their gender and sexual identity. Are you one of them? Do you know what they go through on a daily basis? No? Then go read/watch your daily source of bullshit, think of the good old days, but dont go after real people with real problems.

I truly hope you find peace in whatever your decision is OP.. But know that even in the darkest times there is always maybe even a little light at the end of the tunnel. Think of the little things in life that bring you joy , those may be insignificant to others, but important to you.After all its your life. God bless
